primary_claim: Adding noise to the weights of a sandbagging Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct model can increase its GSM8k performance (revealing hidden capability), replicating the main effect from 'Noise Injection Reveals Hidden Capabilities of Sandbagging Language Models' with a different model and dataset.

effect.metric: accuracy on 350 GSM8k questions vs weight noise level
effect.value: for some seeds, accuracy of the sandbagging-prompted model increases as noise is added, while the normal-prompted model's accuracy decreases with noise

stated_future_work: Any extension to the project ought to include unit tests to check the noise-scaling-per-seed implementation
limitations_stated: Not 100% certain the code correctly scales the same underlying noise across noise levels for a fixed seed
Only used the first 350 GSM8k questions due to GPU/batch size constraints
Setting temperature to 0 does not necessarily give deterministic outputs in practice
Whether sandbagging occurs is highly sensitive to prompt wording
quote: If you add noise to the parameters of a model that is sandbagging, then sometimes its performance on a task can increase.
